welcomeMessage.text: Hello and welcome to FreshFind (eGreen Basket)! 🌿 I can help you find open markets, explore seasonal produce, check schedules, or navigate our platform. What would you like to explore today?
quickReplies: What produce is in season now?
Where can I buy fresh apples?

rules.response: Several markets operate on scheduled days throughout the week! Downtown Green Commons is open Wednesdays & Saturdays, Riverfront is open Sundays, and Eastside Greenway operates Monday & Thursday evenings. You can view all live schedules in our Market Directory.
Our Seasonal Recommendations guide spotlights peak harvests! Right now in Autumn, you'll find Honeycrisp apples, butternut squash, wild chanterelles, and crisp Asian pears at their absolute freshest.
Heritage Honeycrisp and Gala apples are currently in peak season! You can find them at the Downtown Green Commons Market, Riverfront Orchard Market, and Highland Valley Sunrise Market.
Fresh vine-ripened Heirloom Brandywine Tomatoes are available at Downtown Green Commons, Oakridge Community Market, and Eastside Greenway Twilight Market.
Pacific wild chanterelles and oyster mushrooms are hand-foraged and available at Oakridge Community Market and Westside Artisanal & Farm Bazaar.
Downtown Green Commons Market is open Wednesdays (10 AM - 2 PM) and Saturdays (8:30 AM - 2 PM) at 1200 SW Park Avenue. It features 60+ farms, cheese makers, and live folk music.
You can click the heart bookmark icon on any market card or produce item to save it! In the Bookmarks page, you can attach session notes, copy or download your formatted list, and share with friends.

Yes! Most of our partner markets (including Downtown, Riverfront, Oakridge, and Westside) proudly accept SNAP/EBT and offer the Double Up Food Bucks program. Vendors also accept cash, debit/credit cards, and market tokens.

Downtown Green Commons, Riverfront Orchard, Westside Bazaar, Highland Valley, and Eastside Greenway are all dog-friendly on standard leashes! Oakridge Community Market does not allow pets in the main field due to school park regulations.

Every market detail page includes parking instructions. Downtown offers an underground garage with 1st-hour validation, Oakridge has free school parking, and Riverfront has public marina parking. Bike corrals are available at all locations!
You can reach the FreshFind team at hello@freshfind-egreen.org or (503) 555-0100. Our community hub is at 400 Greenways Blvd, Metropolis. Check our Contact Us page for a live map and inquiry form!
FreshFind (theme: eGreen Basket) is a community initiative dedicated to connecting neighbors with local growers, shortening the food supply chain, and celebrating regional seasonal agriculture.
